description: Explore the heritage behind Ashburton Hall & Park and the local area. All of Ashburton Hall and cafe will be open with guided tours, object handling, free craft activities and storytelling all inspired by the park and its history, as a former convent and library. There will also be a chance to give feedback and see plans for the park's new £1 million renovation phase in its centenary year.

factsheet.heading: Celebrating 100 Years of Ashburton Park
paragraphs: Join us at Ashburton Park to hear more about this fascinating heritage building dating to the 1860s and our 3-yr restoration project funded by the Heritage Fund.

Visitors will be able to discover more about the park’s past, from its origins as the grounds of a grand estate, orphanage and hospital to its transformation into a park, library & public space at the heart of the local community.
There will be an opportunity to learn about the development of the park over the decades and  opportunities to hear how we are embedding heritage within our restoration project (2025-2028).
